title: An Integrative Multi-Omic Characterization of Head and Neck Carcinogenesis, Progression and Recurrence
official: An Integrative Multi-Omic Characterization of Head and Neck Carcinogenesis, Progression and Recurrence
summary: This study evaluates the cell and biomarkers associated with the aggressive behavior of cancer.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis/disease status: New diagnosis of head and neck cancer
* Allowable type and amount of prior therapy: No prior treatment
* Age ≥ 18 years.
* Ability to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have had treatment of head and neck cancer
